policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: LG Display has introduced FLiPP (FMM-Less innovative Pixel Patterning), a new OLED manufacturing method designed to produce brighter, more efficient, longer-lasting, and nearly any-size display panels.
Slack is launching collaborative 'vibe-coding' channels that incorporate AI agents, aiming to allow teams to code together more seamlessly without switching between multiple tools and conversations.

Scientists are actively searching for new sources of hydrogen, with the potential for the gas or the conditions to produce it to be hidden underground, which could offer a significant climate solution.

world.summary: Hui Ka Yan, the founder of Chinese property developer Evergrande, has been sentenced to life in prison for fraud, and all his personal property has been confiscated.
The U.S. gross national debt has surpassed $40 trillion for the first time, a figure that has doubled over the last decade due to increased spending under both the Trump and Biden administrations.

Kyiv experienced one of the most intense Russian missile and drone bombardments since the start of the war, resulting in at least 15 fatalities and hitting residential areas and a children's hospital.
